pins.title: Where Is Your Main Water Shutoff? Verify Before Turning
heading: A valve nearby
is not proof.
lines: Start at the water entry point
pins.description: Locate your home’s main water shutoff before an emergency. Nearby valves can serve individual fixtures or utility equipment. Use the free guide to find the right starting point and confirm the control; do not force unfamiliar valves.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: A valve nearby is not proof. Start at the water entry point; Confirm what the valve controls; Ask your provider or plumber.

pins.title: House Shutoff or Utility Valve? Know the Difference
heading: House valve?
Utility valve?
pins.description: A meter-box valve is not automatically yours to operate. The free guide explains house, fixture and utility controls with primary utility sources and clear local limits. Ask your own water provider which control is permitted.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: House valve? Utility valve? Meter boxes can hold both; Local rules decide who operates; Confirm before touching.

pins.title: The Missing Detail in Your Water Shutoff Record
heading: Who confirmed
the control?
lines: Add who checked it and when
pins.description: A useful shutoff record includes more than a room name. Use the free handoff prompts for the verified location, what it controls, who confirmed it, instruction reference and appropriate contacts. Keep completed records private.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: Who confirmed the control? Record the verified location; Add who checked it and when; Keep the instructions nearby.

pins.title: Can Another Household Member Find the Water Shutoff?
heading: A clear route
beats “basement.”
pins.description: After the correct water control is verified, write a clear route and keep access unobstructed. The free guide helps you organize a private household note without buying software or sharing your home’s details publicly.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: A clear route beats “basement.” Name the room and wall; Keep the path accessible; Use a verified private note.
